# Andesine

> Andesine is an open-source workspace for docs, knowledge, and structured content. Teams write in a real-time editor with properties, schemas, and custom elements. AI agents read and edit content through the API and MCP server. Content publishes to hosted docs sites, GitHub, or any app. Use the cloud app or self-host it.

## Product

- [Home](https://andesine.app/index.md): Use cases, workspace, publishing, open source, and pricing.
- [Pricing](https://andesine.app/pricing/): Plans, limits, and a plan comparison.
- [Andesine Pages](https://andesine.app/pages/): Docs sites, hosted or built from the open-source template.
- [Documentation](https://andesine.app/docs): Setup, editor, collections, publishing, API, MCP, and self-hosting.
- [Documentation for LLMs](https://andesine.app/docs/llms.txt): Index of the docs as Markdown pages.

## Open source

- [Source code](https://github.com/vriteio/andesine): The repository.
- [Self-hosting](https://andesine.app/docs/self-hosting/): Run Andesine on your own servers.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/vriteio/andesine/releases): Release notes.
